caption:
UK visit visa from Dubai: there is no sticker in your passport anymore.

UK visas are digital now. Your permission lives in an online account linked to your passport — there is nothing physical to show at the gate.

Two consequences. Keep the passport link updated if your details change, and make sure you can actually access the account when you travel. Always confirm current requirements on gov.uk.
